text:
alex_kaplan: quick share — ran the ember-13b quant sweep (fp16 -> int8 -> int6) on our synthetic chat slices. cost vs quality looks interesting, wanted early product/GTN input before we lock routing defaults.

maria_li: nice, any glaring regressions on instruction-following tests?

alex_kaplan: overall pass on conv/chat sims. int8 loses ~1.8% exact-match on our dev prompt set, int6 about ~4.6%. latency drops: int8 ~22% faster p50, int6 ~38%. token cost delta rough calc below.

  // quick calc snippet
  // baseline fp16: $0.012/token (serving unit)
  // int8: ~0.0095/token
  // int6: ~0.0074/token
  // 1M tokens/day: fp16 ~$12k, int8 ~$9.5k, int6 ~$7.4k

taylor_ng: thanks — do we have breakdown by request length? int6 regressions concentrated on longer contexts?

alex_kaplan: good Q. short form (<128 tokens) quality drop is smaller: int8 ~1.1%, int6 ~2.7%. long form (512+) int6 reg >6% on a subset of summarization prompts.

priya_r: product note: GTN cares more about short chat quality; search/rerank teams care about long-context precision. we could recommend hybrid routing.

maria_li: agree. suggest default route to int8 for chat-prod, fallback to fp16 for any high-precision flows. int6 as burst/low-cost for background batch jobs.

alex_kaplan: prototype routing flags I tried: 
```
route: ember-13b
variants:
  - name: ember-13b-int8
    priority: default
  - name: ember-13b-fp16
    predicate: request.metadata.precision == "high"
    fallback: true
  - name: ember-13b-int6
    predicate: request.metadata.tier == "background"
    capacity_tag: cheap
```

ops-bot: deploy pipeline: ember-13b-int8 image build succeeded (ci/ember-13b-int8 #432) :white_check_mark:

priya_r: can we get a compact scorecard for GTN with thresholds they can tweak? e.g., max acceptable EM loss for chat = 2.0%, latency budget p50 <= 120ms, cost savings >20% to prefer quant.

taylor_ng: i'll assemble a 1-pager. also adding signal to config: `quality_signal: delta_em` and `auto-fallback: true` if delta_em > 2.5% for chat routes.

alex_kaplan: perfect. i'll upload detailed eval CSV and sample failing prompts to the internal doc: https://redwood.internal/ember13b/quant-eval (will ping when live).

maria_li: one more ask — add an A/B pilot for 10% of GTN traffic to validate user-facing metrics for 2 weeks before full rollout.

priya_r: +1. product will own the metric pass/fail and cutoff. once we have pilot data, we can formalize routing defaults in platform.

alex_kaplan: thanks all — action items: taylor to produce scorecard + config PR, alex to publish eval artifacts, ops-bot on watch for rollout job. will circle back after pilot. :rocket:
